purpose:
Secondary matched-position throughput context, not an acceptance/tournament test.

Three rotated evaluator/build triples, 12 frozen fixtures, 1000 ms, CPU 0.
Different evaluators visit different trees: NPS ratios are not equal-work cost
or Elo estimates. The primary seven-pair candidate/control test remains separate.

summary.bootstrap_method: 10,000 joint draws, seed 20261017: positions as groups, then same sampled triples for all three builds. Recovery undefined when aggregate baseline reaches/exceeds classical; omitted and counted. Three triples/fixture are descriptive, not an acceptance extension.
summary.warning: Descriptive ratio of geometric group summaries, three repetitions only; not a precise recovery estimate or equal-tree/evaluation-cost/Elo comparison. No earlier-run projection used.
